duties.SUPER_ADMIN: Nyir'urubuga: si umunyamuryango w'ikimina. Ashyiraho amatsinda, ashyira Perezida, areba ikimina yose, kandi afata ububasha bwose iyo abayobozi bakeneye ubufasha.
duties.MEMBER: Ashyira umusanzu buri kwezi, asaba inguzanyo, kandi areba amande, ikigega cy'imibano, n'isaranganya bye.
duties.PRESIDENT: Ayobora itsinda, akemura amakimbirane, ahagarika abanyamuryango, yemeza amategeko, kandi asinya amafaranga ava mu kigega.
duties.VICE_PRESIDENT: Asimbura Perezida iyo adahari, afite ububasha bumwe, kandi ayobora komite y'inguzanyo.
duties.SECRETARY: Abika icyo abanyamuryango, inama, n'ibyemezo. Si umukoresha w'amafaranga.
duties.ACCOUNTANT: Andika imisanzu, inguzanyo zatanzwe, n'uko zishyurwa, kandi ategura isaranganya. Perezida agomba gusinya iyo amafaranga ava mu kigega.
duties.LOAN_OFFICER: Asuzuma ibisabwa by'inguzanyo ku mateka y'imisanzu, yemera cyangwa yanga, hanyuma ayohereza Umucungamari ngo atange amafaranga.
duties.COOPERATIVE_ADMIN: Ayobora itsinda, akemura amakimbirane, ahagarika abanyamuryango, yemeza amategeko, kandi asinya amafaranga ava mu kigega.
